eps.t: The Other Demon in the Misfit Class
eps.ov: The Misfit Class find out they need to compete in the Music Festival and find out they had another student.
The Misfit Class try to figure out what kind of performance they're going to do for the Music Festival.
The Misfit Class decide to do the Hell Dance at the Music Festival and Kalego coaches Iruma and Purson.
Iruma wants to have a chat with Purson.
Purson has disappeared, but Iruma doesn’t give up and decides to talk with him.
Suzuki Iruma and all thirteen students of the Misfit Class must perform to reach Rank 4 at the Music Festival.
Iruma and the rest of the Misfit Class perform their rendition of "Lilith's Carpet."
Iruma and the Misfit Class learn the results of the Music Festival and Purson has a chat with his father.
Asmodeus goes to fetch something from the club room and runs into someone unexpected.
Iruma and Asmodeus spend the day together having fun.

eps.t: Best Friend Meeting / Lead's Flirting Meeting
eps.ov: Iruma explains friendship to the class, while Lead seeks advice on getting closer to Elizabetta.
Ameri goes to the Deviculum and contemplates her current distance with Iruma.
Iruma-kun celebrates his birthday for the first time in the netherworld.

eps.t: Infiltrate the Teacher Dorms! / A New Member Joins the Girls?!
eps.ov: Iruma visits the teacher dorms and Naphula joins the girl squad.

eps.t: The Laws of the Netherworld Dictate That One Takes After Their Master / Even Among Those Who Are Close...
eps.ov: Jazz tries to deal with his familiar and Lead teaches Asmodeus how to play video games.

eps.t: A Misfit Casual Gathering / Netherworld Devotee
eps.ov: The Misfit Class has a party at Iruma's home and then Iruma helps Opera perform their daily duties.
The Thirteen Crowns discuss their future and nominate candidates for the next Demon King.

eps.t: Give the Youth All the Nutrients They Need / Crossing the Sunbeams Shining Through the Trees
eps.ov: The Dinner of the Thirteen Crowns occurs and then Iruma, Asmodeus, and Clara contemplate being second-years.
The Dem-dols Games begins.
Team Devimuse loses a member and gets an unlikely substitute.
Both Gyari and Kuromu make shocking announcements at the Dem-dol Games.
The Dem-Dol Games finally come to a close.

eps.t: The Road to the Demon King
eps.ov: Iruma goes to visit Sabro to find out more about Demon Kings.
The new school year finally begins at Babyls.
